summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #366 exact head f50067d4dedbe548fc80aed2289b846644dd941c: callback-local runtime mutation fencing is sound, but current-main FidelityManager evaluates metatable-backed PolicyInputs before the runtime transition guard is raised, allowing hostile __index code to dispose runtime authority pre-hook. Require #335/equivalent protection in ancestry or extend the full-step runtime fence, then synthesize with overlapping recipe-fence #310 before integration.
evidence: PhysicsLabRuntime.step performs assertMutationAllowed while transitionInFlight is false, then delegates to FidelityManager.step; transitionInFlight is only raised inside the later representation transition hook
Current-main FidelityManager validateInputs dereferences inputs.distanceStuds and other PolicyInputs fields without first requiring a metatable-free plain table
A hostile PolicyInputs __index can call runtime.dispose before the transition hook; dispose sees transitionInFlight false and unregisters registry/fidelity populations
PR #335 head 4a3c55d9d2046df1af6ee93710d395aedd4ea102 explicitly rejects metatable-backed PolicyInputs before field access and hostile nowSeconds/scalars before numeric operators
PR #366 exact-head canonical CI 31482367736 passes and Swarm engine-tests pass, so this is an uncovered dependency/integration defect rather than a compile/test failure
PR #310 overlaps the same PhysicsLabRuntime source/test files and must remain present in the eventual synthesized head
